definition: No main-thread heartbeat in any gated take of the macOS UI benchmark is delayed more than maximumAllowed milliseconds. The statistic is each take's maximumDelayedHeartbeatMS from MainThreadStallWatchdog (a 100 ms heartbeat, so a stall of D ms reads between D-100 and D), including the censored lower bound of any heartbeat still queued when the take ended (frontend heartbeatDelayDefinition completedAndCensoredPending). Gated takes are those scripts/check_macos_ui_bench.py stall_gate_applies selects: the floor tier always, every other Mac tier when it is the host's native tier. calibrationStatus decides what the limit does: provisional reports only (the checker records every gated take's value and whether the run would fail, stallGate.wouldFail in the evidence manifest and the run warning stall.provisional.wouldfail(<above>/<gated>) in the tracked record, and never fails the run); calibrated, which must list the calibrating run IDs in calibrationRuns, fails a run with a take above the limit.
basis: Maintainer decisions 2026-09-25 (benchmark and telemetry audit #6). Replaces the zero-tolerance delayedHeartbeatCount50 gate, which 419 of 464 canonical M2 takes (90.3%) would have failed, with Apple's 250 ms hang threshold. 250 ms is not calibrated either: replayed on the same 464 takes (16 canonical mac-mini-m2-8gb runs, uiMaximumDelayedHeartbeatMS from completed heartbeats only, so before the censored lower bounds, which can only raise it), it fails 189 takes (40.7%) and all 16 runs (1 to 23 of 29 takes each); the four 2026-09-14 runs have 16 to 23 takes above it and per-run medians of 295-353 ms. The M6 runs another tier on faster hardware, so its distribution is unknown. The provisional limit therefore reports only and never fails a run (second decision, same day): the checker prints every gated take's value (cell=value) to benchmark-gate.txt and keeps the distribution in the evidence manifest whether or not the run would fail. It stays provisional until one exploratory scripts/ui_test.sh macos benchmark on mac-mini-m6-16gb has recorded that distribution; the statistic and limit are then re-declared here with calibrationStatus calibrated and that run in calibrationRuns, and only then does the limit gate.
